claim.quote: We report the first detection of the gravitational lensing of the cosmic microwave background through a measurement of the four-point correlation function in the temperature maps made by the Atacama Cosmology Telescope.

name: Detection of the Power Spectrum of Cosmic Microwave Background Lensing by the Atacama Cosmology Telescope

official_url.quote: Detection of the Power Spectrum of Cosmic Microwave Background Lensing by the Atacama Cosmology Telescope

significance.quote: Since the amplitude of the convergence power spectrum scales as the square of the amplitude of the density fluctuations, the 4-sigma detection of the lensing signal measures the amplitude of density fluctuations to 12%.

summary.plain: ACT made the first detection of gravitational lensing of the Big Bang afterglow from the CMB alone, using the way matter along the line of sight distorts the temperature map. The signal matched the standard cosmological model.
summary.technical: ACT MBAC temperature maps: four-point-function estimate of the lensing convergence power spectrum at 2-degree scales; 4-sigma detection, density-fluctuation amplitude measured to 12%, consistent with LCDM.

title: Detection of the Power Spectrum of Cosmic Microwave Background Lensing by the Atacama Cosmology Telescope
why_it_matters: The abstract says the lensing power spectrum measures "the amplitude of matter density fluctuations on comoving length scales of around 100 Mpc at redshifts around 0.5 to 3".
